---
title: DASCore Development Installation
---

Clone the integration branch and fetch the version tags:

```bash
git clone --branch dev https://github.com/DASDAE/dascore.git
cd dascore
git fetch --tags
```

Use an isolated environment. With [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/):

```bash
uv venv
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

Or with [mamba](https://mamba.readthedocs.io/):

```bash
mamba env create -f environment.yml
mamba activate dascore
pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

Install the commit hooks:

```bash
pre-commit install -f
```

To refresh an existing checkout, activate its environment and run:

```bash
git switch dev
git pull --tags origin dev
uv pip install -e ".[dev]"
```

If `origin` is your fork, replace `origin` with `upstream`.

Use `pip` instead of `uv pip` in a mamba environment.
